items.title: 68113_Barney Bigard oral history interview
items.q: So with the manager -- we had a little manager, Sam Flaschnik was his name -- and Herb and myself, whatever restaurant we'd see, we'd go up and we'd stop.

ctx.x: -- and so he said that was the main thing he did with the band, "Barney and I would go out and get the food or the band wouldn't have eaten." Is that right?

That's right. We came to St. Louis from a gig and so there wasn't a restaurant available to get something to eat. There was some, you know, but you couldn't go in there, see. So with the manager -- we had a little manager, Sam Flaschnik was his name -- and Herb and myself, whatever restaurant we'd see, we'd go up and we'd stop. So we saw this restaurant, there was nobody in it, the lights on. So Flaschnik said, "Watch, I'll fix that." He said, "Stop the bus back here and I'll go in front there." So he and Herb…
